task.description:
WF-03 FAST-TRACK: Fix three backend issues blocking Alice's post-onboarding workspace login.

Branch: feature/WF03-tenant-auth-20260616
fn:git-setup first, then implement all three fixes.

## Fix 1 — ISS-UAT-V6-001: Add realm-roles mapper to provisioned Keycloak client

In src/identity/onboarding.zig OR src/identity/provider/adapters/keycloak/provider.zig (provisionClient):
After creating the Keycloak client for a new tenant realm, add a protocol mapper of type 'oidc-usermodel-realm-role-mapper' to embed realm roles in the JWT.

The mapper payload to POST to /admin/realms/{realm}/clients/{clientId}/protocol-mappers/models:
  {
    "name": "realm roles",
    "protocol": "openid-connect",
    "protocolMapper": "oidc-usermodel-realm-role-mapper",
    "config": {
      "claim.name": "realm_access.roles",
      "jsonType.label": "String",
      "access.token.claim": "true",
      "id.token.claim": "false",
      "multivalued": "true"
    }
  }

Check: does createStandardRoles (or similar) in provider.zig already add mappers? Read the code first.

## Fix 2 — ISS-UAT-V6-002: Backend must accept tokens from tenant realms

The backend has BPM_IDP_EXPECTED_ISSUER=http://localhost:8081/realms/bpm-default. Alice's swiftroute token has iss=http://localhost:8081/realms/swiftroute → rejected.

In src/api/middleware/auth.zig, look for where the issuer is validated.
Option A: When BPM_IDP_EXPECTED_ISSUER is set, only validate it for platform-admin tokens (bpm-default realm). For tenant-realm tokens, validate the issuer dynamically against the tenant's registered oidc_authority (from public.tenant table).
Option B (simpler): If the token's iss matches any registered tenant realm (SELECT idp_realm_id FROM public.tenant WHERE iss = tenant_oidc_authority), accept it.

Read auth.zig to understand the current validation flow. Implement the simplest correct approach that doesn't break existing tests.

Security rule: NEVER skip issuer validation entirely. Always validate iss against either the expected issuer or a registered tenant realm. No SQL string interpolation.

## Fix 3 — ISS-UAT-V6-003: Add platform callback URL to Keycloak client redirect_uris

In the onboarding saga (src/identity/onboarding.zig OR provider.zig provisionClient):
When creating the Keycloak client for a tenant, add the platform's own base URL patterns to redirect_uris alongside the tenant-specified ones:
  - http://127.0.0.1:8080/* (or BPM_BASE_URL/* from env)
  - http://127.0.0.1:4173/* (Vite preview port)
  - http://localhost:8080/*
  - http://localhost:4173/*

These are dev-mode URLs. In production, BPM_BASE_URL would be set to the real platform URL.

Alternatively: read BPM_BASE_URL or BPM_PORT from environment and construct the platform callback URL dynamically.

After implementation:
  zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' → must be empty
  zig build → exits 0
  zig build test → exits 0

Commit and push:
  git commit -m 'fix(WF03): realm-roles mapper + tenant issuer validation + platform redirect_uri (ISS-UAT-V6)'
  git push origin feature/WF03-tenant-auth-20260616

Then git-merge (PR + squash merge + delete branch):
  PR title: 'fix(WF03): realm-roles mapper, tenant token issuer validation, platform redirect_uri (ISS-UAT-V6-001/002/003)'
  gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
  git checkout main ; git pull --ff-only origin main
